study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Coupé et al., Human Brain Mapping, 2022
study_identification_part.si4_title: Hippocampal-amygdalo-ventricular atrophy score: Alzheimer disease detection using normative and pathological lifespan models

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The abstract states the objective to present an MRI-based method (HAVAs) using normative and AD lifespan models for AD detection and MCI prognosis, clearly articulating the study’s aims and the purpose of applying normative modeling.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: "we present an innovative MRI-based method for Alzheimer disease (AD) detection and mild cognitive impairment (MCI) prognostic, using lifespan trajectories of brain structures... [a] Hippocampal-Amygdalo-Ventricular Atrophy score (HAVAs) based on normative lifespan models and AD lifespan models."

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: Eligibility is operationalized via CN status in multiple open datasets; image QC is described (automatic QC + visual review) and final sample sizes are reported. However, detailed inclusion/exclusion criteria per dataset and explicit counts of exclusions are not fully specified.
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: "Our training dataset was composed of 3,032 T1-weighted (T1w) MRI from seven open access databases... 2,655 CN subjects (CN) and 377 patients with AD."; "we performed a QC procedure... automatic QC RegQCNet... a visual assessment... If the failure was confirmed... the subject was removed from training dataset."
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.location: Materials and Method – 2.1.1 Training dataset (table and text); 2.2 Image processing (QC paragraph)

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: Age is the central covariate through lifespan modeling; volumes are normalized by ICV and z-scored across CN lifespan. There is no explicit handling of sex or multi-site effects (e.g., site covariate or harmonization like ComBat).
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text: "we normalized all the structure volumes using the intracranial cavity volume (ICV)... we performed z-score normalization... using all the CN subjects over the entire lifespan."; "To create our lifespan models, we estimated normal and pathological trajectories... across the entire lifespan."

nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.reason: The study specifies the open datasets used for the reference cohort with names and counts (C-MIND, NDAR, ABIDE, ICBM, IXI, OASIS, ADNI).
nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.supporting_text: Training dataset table lists: C-MIND, NDAR, ABIDE, ICBM, IXI, OASIS, ADNI (CN); OASIS and ADNI (AD).

nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.reason: Secondary data from existing open datasets are used; per guidance, acquisition protocol details are not applicable here.
nm4_image_acquisition_protocol.supporting_text: "training dataset... from seven open access databases"

nm5_data_preprocessing.reason: Preprocessing is clearly described using AssemblyNet with specific steps: denoising, inhomogeneity correction (N4/N3), affine registration to MNI, automatic QC (RegQCNet), second bias correction, intensity standardization, followed by multi-network segmentation.
nm5_data_preprocessing.supporting_text: "All the considered images were processed using AssemblyNet... preprocessing pipeline... image denoising... inhomogeneity correction... affine registration to the MNI space, automatic quality control (QC)... a second inhomogeneity correction... final intensity standardization... After preprocessing, the brain was segmented... using 250 DL models."

nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.reason: The work estimates trajectories on the training dataset and validates performance on external datasets. No internal partitioning (e.g., CV/hold-out) for the reference cohort modeling is described.
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: "To validate our model, we built a testing dataset based on two open access databases (AIBL and MIRIAD)..."

nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.reason: Models are applied to independent external datasets (AIBL, MIRIAD for AD vs CN; ADNI for sMCI/pMCI).
nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: "To validate our model, we built a testing dataset based on two open access databases (AIBL and MIRIAD)... In addition, we used subjects with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) from ADNI..."

nm8_normative_modeling_approach.reason: The statistical approach is described: low-order polynomial regression (linear/quadratic/cubic), model selection via ANOVA/T-tests and BIC, 95% CIs, Euclidean distance for classification, and probability scoring. However, implementation software/libraries for the modeling are not specified.
nm8_normative_modeling_approach.supporting_text: "To estimate the volume trajectories, we considered several low order polynomial models... [linear/quadratic/cubic]... candidate only when... ANOVA... coefficients... T-statistic... select... Bayesian Information Criterion... estimate the confidence interval..."; "we... estimated the closest lifespan trajectory in terms of Euclidean distance... proposed new scores... ensure that when AD score is higher than 50%..."
